issues.evidence: cuts_without_sound_event_s lists 25 of 45 cuts (55.6%); hook 14 of 26. The V39 fill only adds click+whoosh when NO non-VO cue lies within 0.25 s, and fading-in beds count: 54.4/64.4/91.8 (ticktock, 0.4 s fade-in), 106.3 (office + heart_slow fade-ins), 112.4 (birds 0.4 s fade), 115.3 (birds 0.6 s fade), 52.6 (key at 0.12). In the hook, whoosh2 at 0.18 under VO (16.5, 22.97, 36.77, 45.63) is not detected.
issues.suggested_action: Exclude beds/fade-ins (ticktock, office, birds, city, heart_, bass_pulse) from the 'already covered' test and require a cue with fi==0 and vol >= 0.25 within 60 ms before the cut; raise hook cut whooshes to 0.3 and high-pass them at 300 Hz so they read over beds.
